=== Source formats ===
The original Set 0 slip says “immediately fire” after the opponent initiates battle.<ref>[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 6. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The July 2018 full-card image and July 2022 remastered image print the same game text.<ref>Players Committee Holotable repository, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/defensivefire.gif publisher image].</ref><ref>Players Committee Holotable repository, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/defensivefire.gif publisher image].</ref> The 2022 remaster uses a newly laid-out text panel. The left inset is wider, and the margin caption drops the bullet. The printed title keeps its uniqueness dot. Both images use the same game text and icon.

|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Defensive Fire (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), a re-made card image with the same words. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-defensivefire-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-defensivefire022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/defensivefire.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/defensivefire.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Defensive Fire”. Text: “If opponent just initiated battle, immediately fire a non-lightsaber, non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon present (for free and each weapon destiny is +2). That weapon may fire again this battle.”
*: The card was printed earlier on page 6 of the Players Committee's Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0 (copy captured 6 August 2016; see Source formats below).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Defensive Fire (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-defensivefireab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/defensivefire.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/defensivefire.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Defensive Fire” → “Defensive Fire” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Defensive Fire”. Text: “If opponent just initiated battle, immediately fire a non-lightsaber, non-[Permanent Weapon] weapon present (for free and each weapon destiny is +2). That weapon may fire again this battle.”
